pips suicide prevention ireland weekend crisis hopeline, a regional overnight telephone service available friday and sunday nights, to anyone across northern ireland experiencing emotional distress, suicidal thoughts, or a mental health crisis.
the operational hours for the weekend crisis hopeline are as follows.
friday: 9pm - 10am saturday sunday: 9pm - 9am monday 028 $080 5850 | freephone 0800 088 6042

the weekend crisis hopeline provides a confidential, non-judgemental space to talk with a trained crisis practitloner when someone is in distress, needs support or simply wants someone to talk to during a difficult time outside of usual working hours.
there is no referral process for the hopeline, and individuals can contact us directly whenever they feel in need of support.
